scope: Synthetic metadata/field metrics; software checks of field-to-section-to-unit aggregation and statistics. No image measurement pipeline or external biological validation.
limitations: Input source identities are declared synthetic labels, not hashes of real image files.
The 15-field-per-group cases contain three declared units per group; fields are not independent biological replicates.
Dunnett comparison uses five fixed-seed SciPy randomized integrations with absolute tolerance 0.0005; extreme-tail precision is not established.
The current hashed working tree is tested, not a pristine release or subsequent code revision.
Correct user identification of sources and independence, real-image metric accuracy and GUI behavior are outside this check.

_public_export.scope: Selected original summary/identity fields only. This export does not rerun tests and does not certify later integrated PR commits.
